en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a broad river with a stone embankment in the foreground. A paddle steamship with a smoking funnel moves along the water. Across the river stands a large castle-like complex with high walls, a round corner tower and several tall spires and roofs, behind a line of trees and lower houses. To the left a multi‑span iron bridge crosses the river. The sky area on the upper left is heavily damaged or overexposed, leaving a large white blotch.
